title: Tests for Skill Tab CRUD operations
action: Add tests verifying: (1) create skill from template, (2) edit skill content, (3) rename skill, (4) delete with confirmation, (5) cancel delete preserves skill.

criteria: All new SkillTab CRUD tests pass

implementation: 1) Mock skill API functions (createSkill, saveSkill, deleteSkill, renameSkill). 2) Test create: click + button, fill name, verify createSkill called. 3) Test edit: select skill, modify textarea content, click save, verify saveSkill called. 4) Test rename: click rename, change name, verify renameSkill called. 5) Test delete: click delete, verify confirmation dialog, click confirm, verify deleteSkill called. 6) Test cancel delete: click delete, click cancel, verify skill preserved.
